ev.q: one cluster of five KPC-CRE isolates with two closely related PFGE patterns was detected among four inpatients
Isolates from patients A and B each differed from isolates from patients C and D by only one hqSNP
PFGE has been conducted on 225 CRE isolates (average = ~50 per year)
all were non-Hispanic whites, and two were women
Median age of the four patients was 65 years (range = 52–75 years)
Isolates from patients A and B each differed from isolates from patients C and D by only one hqSNP
A subsequent investigation included analysis of routine PFGE subtyping to detect clusters

methods_quotes.q: CRE isolates with PFGE patterns that are indistinguishable or closely related (1–2 band difference) are reported
The bootstrap statistical method (resampling with replacement) was used to assess phylogenetic variation among genes in the WGS.
100 bootstraps performed; bootstraps with <50% confidence are not labeled at their nodes.
